← Back to the journalPACKAGING NOTES

A guide to finding your perfect box.

Start with the product. Then consider how you want the moment of opening to feel.

01

Begin with what goes inside.

Measure the product, including any protective wrapping, and consider its weight and fragility. Leave room for an insert where support is needed. A beautiful exterior works best when the fit inside is equally considered.

02

Choose the opening experience.

A lid-and-base box is timeless and direct. A magnetic book-style box opens with a deliberate gesture. A drawer creates a slower reveal. A mailer balances the unboxing moment with the practical needs of shipping.

03

Think about the whole journey.

Consider storage, packing, transport and the final presentation together. Request a physical sample before approving a production run, and confirm the final structure, materials and tolerances against the real product.
